name: MusicGroundingBench (MGBench)
description: MusicGroundingBench (MGBench) is a controlled benchmark for note-level temporal grounding and music understanding on algorithmically generated monophonic piano audio with exact symbolic alignment. Every clip comes with its MIDI, its note list, and question–answer pairs whose reference answers are computed from the notes and independently re-verified. MGBench-3N: 6,000 clips of one to three notes covering all 88 piano keys; 69,145 grounding QA pairs. MGBench-2B: 10,844 two-bar monophonic excerpts; 39,974 grounding and 43,567 understanding QA pairs over seven concepts (rhythm, tonality, interval, bar comparison, harmony, repetition, harmonic pattern). In total 16,844 clips and 152,686 QA pairs in clip-disjoint train / val / test splits. The evaluation set test has one question per test clip (3N: 900; 2B: 1,035 grounding, 1,078 understanding); test-full contains every question on the test clips. Audio was rendered from MIDI with Pianoteq 9 Stage (WAV, 44.1 kHz, 16-bit, stereo). See README.md for the file layout and the QA format. Accompanies the paper Note-Level Temporal Grounding of Musical Concepts in Large Audio-Language Models (Kun Fang, Ziyu Wang, Ichiro Fujinaga; arXiv:2608.29480). Code and demo: github.com/kunfang98927/musicgroundingbench.
